full_judgment: 5. It is not disputed that the properties in both schedules originally belonged to Mr Taskinuddin Ahmed, popularly known as Mr T Ahmed, a Senior Advocate of Dhaka District Bar. This T Ahmed is a Public Prosecutor. It is he who has purchased the properties by a registered instrument in the year 1950 AD for a valuable consideration. The petitioners have furnished the deed in original which is Annexure-C to the writ application. This along with other papers showing payment of rents, taxes and rules establishes the ownership of the properties by Mr T Ahmed. Now in order to find that the property in question is an abandoned property one has to ascertain whether Mr Taskinuddin Ahmed alias T Ahmed had left Bangladesh on or about 25th March, 1971 when the President''s Order 16 of 1972 came into force or left the properties uncared for during the relevant time which would bring the property within the definition of Abandoned Property, Article 2(1) of the President''s Order 16 of 1972.
